card.name: Clinician credits and reviewer bylines
card.fires_on: Words in author, reviewer and credential lines, such as Teacher or Physician after a name, MD after a name, and 'in' before a specialty. Also seen in citation details like journal and edition years.

modes.label: Job titles and degrees
modes.description: Role or degree words right after a person's name in a byline or reviewer line.
modes.example: Reviewer: Purvee S. Shah,<< MD>> - Review Date: 09

modes.label: Specialty phrasing
modes.description: Small words or word endings leading into a medical specialty or skill.
modes.example: He completed residency training<< in>> Emergency Medicine at Newark Beth Israel Medical Center

modes.label: Citation pieces
modes.description: Parts of references, journal names and dates in source lists.

card.writes: It suppresses the word client and its Chinese equivalents, so it steers away from client-related wording.
card.plain: It lights up on names and titles of the doctors and reviewers credited at the end of a health article.
